description: This file defines the 'Article' class within the Opencart.Catalog.Model.Cms namespace, containing methods for CRUD operations related to articles, comments, ratings, and associated data management in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents the data model for articles within the Cms namespace; handles CRUD operations, searching, rating updates, and comment management for articles.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a single article by its ID.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches a list of articles based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total count of articles matching the specified filters.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID associated with a specific article.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating value for a given article.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a new comment to an article and returns the comment ID.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment by its ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Lists comments for a specific article with optional filtering.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating for a specific comment.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Returns the total count of comments for an article based on filters.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Retrieves the total count of comments for a specific article, filtered optionally by customer and parent comment ID.

methods.name: addRating
methods.description: Adds a rating for a specific article comment, including details such as store, customer, and IP address.

methods.name: deleteRatings
methods.description: Removes ratings for a specific article comment, scoped by article and customer ID.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Fetches rating statistics for an article, optionally for a specific comment, grouped by rating value.
